sections.content: Bring together *cuando* and *mientras* with the pretérito indefinido to recount a volunteering day. Say when events happened, connect actions happening together, and move from one completed event to the next.

items.english: When we arrived, we received the gloves.
While we worked, we collected rubbish.

items.spanish: Cuando terminó la actividad, el parque estuvo limpio.
items.english: When the activity ended, the park was clean.

sections.content: Think of the three connectors as marking points on a timeline: *cuando* pins down the starting moment, *mientras* fills in what happened alongside it, and *después* moves the story on to what came next.
